description: Ask a person to approve or decline something before you go on. Foundaree emails them a link with Approve and Decline buttons that works without signing in, and says who is asking. Use it when the user wants a manager, client, partner or family member to say yes first ("ask Rahul to approve this order"). Read the request back to the user and get their yes before sending: it is an email from them to a real person. Then use check_approval for the answer, and only go ahead when it says approved. Never put passwords, codes or card numbers in it.

approver_email.description: The approver's email address, given by the user.

details.description: Anything the approver needs to decide: amounts, dates, why.

title.description: What to approve, in one line: "Order 50 chairs for ₹45,000".

name: request_approval
title: Ask someone to approve by link
